name: Punawale
civicNote: Brought into PCMC from gram panchayat in 1997.
summary: A fast-growing residential area in Pimpri-Chinchwad between Tathawade and Ravet, along the Mumbai-Bengaluru highway near the Wakad and Hinjewadi IT hubs.
knownFor: Forest area of more than 60 acres within the locality
Close to the Wakad and Hinjewadi IT hubs
connectivity: Mumbai-Bengaluru highway runs along the area
Road access to Wakad, Tathawade and Ravet
suits: People who want to live close to the Hinjewadi-Wakad IT corridor in a newer residential area.
